mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.name, t1.parent_id, t1.path, t1.component, t1.icon, t1.sort, t1.visible, t1.redirect, t1.type, t3.code FROM sys_menu t1 LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu t2 ON t1.id = t2.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role t3 ON t2.role_id = t3.id WHERE t1.type != '${@com.cloud.system.common.enums.MenuTypeEnum@BUTTON.getValue()}' ORDER BY t1.sort asc

SELECT DISTINCT m.id FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu p ON CONCAT(',', m.tree_path, ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', p.id, ',%') WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT t1.perm FROM sys_menu t1 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu t2 ON t1.id = t2.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_role t3 ON t3.id = t2.role_id WHERE t1.type = '${@com.cloud.system.common.enums.MenuTypeEnum@BUTTON.getValue()}' AND t1.perm IS NOT NULL
AND t3.CODE IN
#{role}
AND t1.id = -1
